preamble.title: cardano-foundation/onboarding-linked-list
preamble.description: An authenticated participant registry, in one datum and as a linked list

aiken_design_patterns/linked_list/Elemen.title: ElementData
aiken_design_patterns/linked_list/Elemen.description:
Root or node payload carried by an `Element`.

 Operation callbacks usually provide the element key alongside the raw
 payload data. `None` for the key means the data came from a `Root`;
 `Some(key)` means it came from a `Node`.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

registry/Entry.title: Entry
registry/Entry.description: The baseline stores every participant in one authenticated datum.

registry/ListDatum.title: ListDatum
registry/ListDatum.description:
Datum stored at each list UTxO: either the root or a node, plus its
 successor link.

 Terminology:
 - `Root` is the first element of the list.
 - `Node` is any non-root list element.
 - `Element` is the umbrella term for either a root or a node.

 Contracts using this library must define their datums as an applied datum
 alias:
 ```aiken
 pub type Datum = linked_list.Element<RootType, NodeType>
 ```

 Where `RootType` and `NodeType` are application-specific custom types.

registry/Query.title: Query
registry/Query.description:
Query demonstrations spend a separate probe, reading the registry without
 spending it. In an application, the query key comes from its business rules.
